svg.text: PART A - priority mux chain (each stage: if valid_k then colour_k else previous result)
PART B - sync / blank delay line (match the mixer's pipeline depth so sync stays aligned with colour)
Fig 10 - Pixel Priority Mixer, Sync Delay Line and VGA Output Registers

Priority HUD > Big bullet > Bullet > Tank > Wall > Background (one mux per level, highest priority last = closest to the output). All inputs are aligned to the same pixel (each source has 1-2 clk latency).
Because later muxes override earlier ones, the final priority is HUD > Big bullet > Bullet > Tank > Wall > Background,
exactly the order required by the project spec. Wall colour comes from the maze renderer (Fig 11); floor = BG_COLOR.
3 FFs = sprite ROM (1) + wall tile fetch (1) + output register (1). Sync pulses are active-low: NOT gates make hsync_n / vsync_n.
